'''Jombo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunter and criminal. Around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], after learning that the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gamgalon]] was organizing safaris on [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]] to cover a gunrunning operation, Jombo joined Gamgalon's criminal organization. He said little, keeping his opinions to himself.

==Behind the scenes==
Jombo appears briefly in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s short story ''[[First Contact]]'', which was published in [[1994]]'s [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]] by [[West End Games]]. The extra background material was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]]. Because Jombo's name only appeared in the supplementary information, the character was not referred to by name when the story was reprinted in ''[[Tales from the Empire]]'' or on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|''Hyperspace'']], as neither reproduced the RPG material that accompanied the original story.
